name: get_problems_by_name
description: Retrieve a list of problems associated with a specified item by its name, including drugs and their side effects. Use this tool when you need to find issues or challenges related to a specific entity (e.g., a product, service, drug, or concept). Do NOT use this tool for general inquiries or unrelated topics; for broader searches, consider using 'search_general_issues'.

parameters.name: item_name
parameters.description: The name of the item for which to retrieve associated problems. Must be a non-empty string, with a maximum length of 255 characters.

parameters.name: include_details
parameters.description: Whether to include detailed descriptions of each problem. Set to false to receive only problem titles for a concise response. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Maximum number of problems to return. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 10 if not specified.

problems.description: List of problems associated with the specified item. Each item includes: title (string), and optionally description (string) if include_details is true.

total_count.description: Total number of problems found for the specified item, which may exceed max_results.

return_schema.description: Object containing a list of problems and the total count of problems found.
